newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria in oil venture with Texas firm.
newsitem.headline: Algeria in oil venture with Texas firm.

text.p: Algeria's state-owned oil and natural gas company Sonatrach has set up a 40-60 oil joint venture with the Texas-based oil exploration firm M-I Drillings Fluids, the official Algerian news agency APS said Saturady.
The joint-venture M-I Algeria Spa will be based in Algeria's main oil producing Hassi Messaoud southern region, it said.
The new firm would provide engineering services, finance services and trade chemical products to the oil fields in Algeria, it added.
The venture was officially agreed by the state-investement regulatory agency.
M-I Drillings Fluids has a 60 percent stake in the joint venture worth $4.5 million while Sonatrach has a 40 percent with an investment of 247.8 million dinar ($4.6 million), said APS.
